description: Ratios for movements with no detector at RCRC site 1444. ratio = movement volume / total volume of the basis movements in the same interval. Central value: each slip lane is assumed to carry the average per-lane volume of the counted stop-bar lanes beside it, so central = slip lanes / counted lanes on the approach (an assumption informed by the HCM convention of distributing a volume evenly over parallel lanes; no source applies it across movements). Low = half and high = double the central value. Replace with turning counts if RCRC provides them.

shares.note: West: 1 slip lane (LANE_W_4) beside 3 counted lanes (LANE_W_1 to LANE_W_3).
North: 1 slip lane (LANE_N_4) beside 3 counted lanes (LANE_N_1 to LANE_N_3).
South: 2 bypass lanes (LANE_S_3, LANE_S_4) beside 2 counted lanes (LANE_S_1, LANE_S_2).
